Class WindowsHWDiskStore

java.lang.Object
oshi.hardware.common.AbstractHWDiskStore
oshi.hardware.common.platform.windows.WindowsHWDiskStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
HWDiskStore
@ThreadSafe public abstract class WindowsHWDiskStore extends AbstractHWDiskStore
Common Windows hard disk implementation shared between JNA and FFM.

    • MSFT_PHYSICAL_DISK_TIMEOUT_MS

      protected static final int MSFT_PHYSICAL_DISK_TIMEOUT_MS
      Timeout for the MSFT_PhysicalDisk fallback query, used when no finite timeout is configured.

      oshi.util.wmi.timeout defaults to infinite, and this query runs in a path callers poll. The Storage WMI provider is markedly less reliable than the storage driver, so it is bounded here: timing out yields the Unknown the caller would have had anyway, where hanging would block getDiskStores() forever.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • updateAttributes

      public boolean updateAttributes()
      Description copied from interface: HWDiskStore
      Make a best effort to update all the statistics about the drive without needing to recreate the drive list. This method provides for more frequent periodic updates of individual drive statistics but may be less efficient to use if updating all drives. It will not detect if a removable drive has been removed and replaced by a different drive in between method calls.
      Returns:
      True if the update was (probably) successful, false if the disk was not found

    • parseWindowsMediaType

      protected static String parseWindowsMediaType(@Nullable String mediaType)
      Parses the Win32_DiskDrive MediaType string into a disk type.

      This property is mapped from DISK_GEOMETRY.MediaType and describes only removability and form factor; its entire value domain is "Fixed hard disk media", "Removable media other than floppy", "External hard disk media" and "Format is unknown". It therefore cannot distinguish an SSD from an HDD, and a fixed or external disk is reported as Unknown rather than guessed at. Use classifyDiskType(StorageProperties, String) to reach the media technology.

      Parameters:
      mediaType - the WMI MediaType value from Win32_DiskDrive
      Returns:
      Removable for removable media, otherwise Unknown

    • classifyDiskType

      protected static String classifyDiskType(@Nullable WindowsHWDiskStore.StorageProperties props, @Nullable String mediaType)

      Returns:

    • diskTypeFromMsftMediaType

      protected static String diskTypeFromMsftMediaType(int mediaType, long spindleSpeed)
      Converts an MSFT_PhysicalDisk MediaType, and the SpindleSpeed that accompanies it, into a disk type.
      Parameters:
      mediaType - the MediaType value: 3 is HDD, 4 is SSD, 5 is storage class memory, 0 is unspecified
      spindleSpeed - the SpindleSpeed in RPM, as an unsigned value. UINT32_MAX means rotating at an unknown speed.
      Returns:
      SSD, HDD, or Unknown

    • buildMsftDiskTypeMap

      protected static Map<String,String> buildMsftDiskTypeMap(WmiResult<MSFTStorage.PhysicalDiskMediaTypeProperty> pd)
      Maps each MSFT_PhysicalDisk DeviceId to a disk type. The DeviceId of a directly attached disk is its physical drive number, matching Win32_DiskDrive's Index.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a map of DeviceId to disk type, omitting disks whose type could not be determined

    • anyDiskTypeUnknown

      protected static boolean anyDiskTypeUnknown(String[] diskTypes)
      Tests whether any disk type is still undetermined, and so whether the Storage namespace fallback is worth its cost. On hardware whose driver answers the seek penalty query this is false and the fallback is skipped.
      Parameters:
      diskTypes - the disk types from classifyDiskTypes(WmiResult, StoragePropertiesResolver)
      Returns:
      true if at least one disk type is Unknown

    • fillUnknownDiskTypes

      protected static void fillUnknownDiskTypes(String[] diskTypes, WmiResult<Win32DiskDrive.DiskDriveProperty> vals, WmiResult<MSFTStorage.PhysicalDiskMediaTypeProperty> pd)
      Fills in the disk types the storage driver could not determine from MSFT_PhysicalDisk. Types the driver did determine are left alone, so a removable or virtual disk is not relabeled by its media technology.
      Parameters:
      diskTypes - the disk types to update in place
      vals - the disk drive query result the types were derived from
      pd - the physical disk media type query result
